# Gauge anomalies

Claims on anomaly cancellation, a well-formalized area of Physlib (`Physlib.QFT.AnomalyCancellation`).

claims.name: standardModel_anomalyFree
claims.statement: The Standard Model gauge group is free of gauge anomalies for each generation.

sources.title: Anomaly cancellation and the Standard Model

claims.name: anomaly_diophantine_solution
claims.statement: Anomaly-cancellation conditions reduce to a system of Diophantine equations with a general solution.

sources.title: A general solution to the anomaly Diophantine equations
